FN-EJKS899-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 318
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 318 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an estimated $100,000 to develop and implement an electronic notification
system to notify a parent or legal guardian when a minor is cited for a traffic violation. The
provisions of this bill are subject to the availability of funding

FN-EJKS899-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 318
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/24/2026
House Bill 318 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by an estimated $100,000 to develop and
implement an electronic notification system to notify a parent or legal guardian when a minor is
cited for a traffic violation. The provisions of this bill are subject to the availability of funding.
